finding.preExistingWorktreeBoundary: prepareWorktree calls privateStateDirectory(workerRoot, exclusive=true) before Git populates the worktree. That call already checks/protects the root on Windows.
finding.cacheReason: The existing root ACL receipt is keyed to the worker root identity. Child private initializers inspect distinct paths, and .room is not the cached sensitive room/ subtree. Thus these are three additional queries, not reuse of the existing call.
finding.boundQualification: Three sequential synchronous queries each have a 20-second configured timeout. This is a configured timeout budget, not measured native Windows latency or a hard wall-clock guarantee including cleanup.

measurement.method: Vitest runs the real Windows private-state dispatch with process.platform set to win32 and PowerShell execFileSync replaced by a valid ACL-report stub. Git and filesystem operations are real.
measurement.regressions: Windows dispatch counter failed before fix with all three child paths; synchronous-filesystem guard failed before fix at lstatSync. Both pass after fix. Event-loop marker is serviced while directory creation awaits a controlled I/O gate.

decision.buildOutput: Ordinary disposable checkout output in an already owned/protected worker worktree. Contains no Room credentials, leases or registry control state. Uses normal inherited directory ACLs, like other project-generated files.
decision.filesystem: Use asynchronous filesystem operations for all metadata, creation, access and reads; retain asynchronous Git checks. Ignore-file reads are bounded and opened without following links where supported.
decision.safety: Continue rejecting linked components, tracked scratch paths, obstructing files, changed ignore files and unwritable output; unavailable output remains non-fatal. Never change checkout ancestor permissions.
decision.audit: Add one exact async mkdir allowance for worker-build-dir.ts in the existing non-state writer audit. Sensitive state still uses the shared private initializer, and duplicate/new writer calls remain rejected. Coordinated a second exact allowance for the submodule owner: temporary Git inspection probe info/attributes under mkdtemp, containing no Room trusted state.
decision.supersedes: Prior choice in 2026-11-21-worker-build-dir-validation.json to apply private-state ACL initialization to build output. Historical test/timing evidence in that report is unchanged.
